applicability: Checking that a constrained support fixture does not obtain vertical support from its rail
Separating ordinary distal contact support from a mere position constraint
claim: In the exact certified L4.0 fixture, the declared rigid strut on an explicit motorless and springless vertical rail free-falls at gravity without a floor and reconstructs approximately 29.4 newtons of aggregate external support through ordinary distal floor contact when the floor is present.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact L4.0 rigid-strut rail oracle, L4.1 hinged-strut static load curve, and L4.3 two-link vertical-carriage support program scopes named by the source-pinned programs. The Generic6DOF vertical rail is an explicit material scaffold whose vertical axis is unlocked and whose observed reaction is retained; ordinary distal floor contact, paired finite joint torque, aggregate external-load reconstruction, crouch/rise work, the declared downward impulse, and exact infeasibility controls retain their fixture, geometry, mass, timestep, solver, controller, and actuator scopes. It establishes rail-constrained articulated vertical support only, not general per-foot allocation, free-root standing or balance, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The declared rigid strut on an explicit motorless and springless vertical rail free-falls at gravity without a floor and reconstructs 29.4 N support through ordinary floor contact, establishing only the exact rail and rigid-geometry oracle.

failure_boundaries: The rail still locks lateral root translation and all root rotation and is therefore a material scaffold
Aggregate external support is not per-contact, per-foot, or per-toe load allocation
No free-root standing, balance, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
mechanism: Unlocking vertical rail translation supplies no vertical support by itself. With the floor absent, gravity changes vertical momentum normally; with ordinary distal contact present, whole-system momentum balance reconstructs the external floor impulse carrying the declared weight.
scope: Only the exact rigid-strut geometry and mass, Generic6DOF vertical-translation rail, ordinary distal floor contact, timestep, solver, thresholds, engine, source, and program claim scope certified by br6a_20260723T121533Z_c0e72549.
title: The certified rigid strut distinguishes rail freefall from ordinary distal support
